falsification_conditions.condition: S&P 500 closes below 4,800 before any new high above 5,600
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern is invalidated because the August 2024 low held with a shallow drawdown (~8%); a break below 4,800 (~14% drawdown) would confirm a deeper bearish structure, not a bottom formation

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes above 35 for two consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom featured VIX peaking near 28 and rapidly mean-reverting; sustained VIX above 35 indicates systemic stress/forced liquidation that contradicts the 'blowoff score 40' mild panic characterization

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y-2Y Treasury yield curve uninverts (10Y yield > 2Y yield by >10bps) while S&P 500 is below 5,200
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The August 2024 bottom occurred with curve deeply inverted (~-50bps); an uninversion during equity weakness signals recession pricing, invalidating the 'soft landing bottom' pattern match

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
